The Technical IntegrationYour repo has the voice assets. Here's the actual workflow:Python   Copy # ElevenLabs v3: Mode-switching via inline tags
import elevenlabs

def generate_response(character_id, mode, text):
    voice_id = CHARACTER_VOICES[character_id]  # Your cloned voice
    
    # Mode-to-tag mapping
    mode_tags = {
        "lullaby": "[whispers] [slowly]",
        "stem": "[excited]",
        "story_time": "[narrator voice]",
        "calm_breathe": "[softly] [slowly]",
        # ... 13 modes
    }
    
    tagged_text = f"{mode_tags[mode]} {text}"
    
    audio = elevenlabs.generate(
        voice=voice_id,
        text=tagged_text,
        model="eleven_v3",  # Expressive model
        voice_settings={
            "stability": 0.3,  # Low = more expressive
            "similarity_boost": 0.75
        }
    )
    return audio Python   Copy # Cartesia Sonic 3: Mode-switching via SSML
import cartesia

def generate_response(character_id, mode, text):
    voice_id = CHARACTER_VOICES[character_id]
    
    # SSML prosody mapping
    mode_ssml = {
        "lullaby": '<prosody rate="slow" pitch="low" volume="soft">',
        "stem": '<prosody rate="fast" pitch="high" volume="loud">',
        # ... 13 modes
    }
    
    ssml_text = f"{mode_ssml[mode]}{text}</prosody>"
    
    audio = cartesia.tts.generate(
        voice=voice_id,
        text=ssml_text,
        model="sonic-3",
        output_format="mp3_44100_128"
    )
    return audio Bottom LineTable  Copy   QuestionAnswer Best for your existing assets?ElevenLabs Professional Voice Cloning.   device_type text CHECK (device_type IN ('wearable','tap_board','tv_dongle')),
  character_id text,
  mode_id text,
  last_seen_at timestamptz,
  battery_level int CHECK (battery_level BETWEEN 0 AND 100),
  is_online boolean DEFAULT false,
  fly_machine_id text -- Fly.io machine ID for routing
);

-- Active sessions (ephemeral, auto-cleanup)
CREATE TABLE sessions (
  id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  parent_id uuid REFERENCES parents(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  device_id uuid REFERENCES devices(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  character_id text NOT NULL,
  mode_id text NOT NULL,
  started_at timestamptz DEFAULT now(),
  last_activity_at timestamptz DEFAULT now(),
  is_active boolean DEFAULT true,
  fly_machine_id text NOT NULL, -- which Fly.io machine handles this session
  -- NO audio storage, NO transcript storage
  CONSTRAINT ephemeral CHECK (is_active = true OR last_activity_at > now() - interval '30 seconds')
);

-- Character configs (130 combos, seeded data)
CREATE TABLE character_modes (
  character_id text NOT NULL,
  mode_id text NOT NULL,
  system_prompt text NOT NULL,
  voice_id text NOT NULL,
  ssml_template text NOT NULL,
  temperature float DEFAULT 0.7,
  max_tokens int DEFAULT 150,
  PRIMARY KEY (character_id, mode_id)
);

-- Medallion registry (NFC tag IDs)
CREATE TABLE medallions (
  id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  parent_id uuid REFERENCES parents(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  medallion_type text CHECK (medallion_type IN ('character','mode','special')),
  character_id text,
  mode_id text,
  nfc_tag_id text UNIQUE NOT NULL,
  is_active boolean DEFAULT true

- /api/kill: proxy to Fly.io kill switch

- devices: device_type, character_id, mode_id, battery, fly_machine_id
- sessions: ephemeral, 30s timeout, no audio/transcript storage

- medallions: nfc_tag_id, character_id, mode_id

- PN532 NFC reader → HTTP POST medallion tap
- Deep sleep between turns, battery reporting
- Jitter buffer → I2S speaker playback

COPPA:
- Verifiable parental consent before first use
- No audio persistence, no transcript storage
- 24hr log retention on Fly.io only
- Parent delete cascades, 30-day hard delete

ERROR HANDLING:
- Deepgram timeout >500ms: retry once, fallback audio
- Groq 429: exponential backoff, max 3 retries
- Cartesia 500char: chunk at sentence boundary
- ESP32 disconnect: 30s session timeout
- Parent kill: immediate broadcast termination
- Battery <10%: sleep command

- ESP32 C skeleton (audio_task, wifi_task, ble_task, nfc_task, wake_word, power_mgmt)
- Supabase schema + seed SQL
- README with env vars and deploy commands

$SecretsFile = "$env:USERPROFILE\.ai-secrets\master.env"

function Load-AISecrets {
    if (Test-Path $SecretsFile) {
        Get-Content $SecretsFile | ForEach-Object {
            if ($_ -match '^\s*([^#][^=]+)\s*=\s*(.*)\s*$') {
                [Environment]::SetEnvironmentVariable($matches[1], $matches[2], "Process")
            }
        }
        Write-Host "🔑 AI secrets loaded from $SecretsFile" -ForegroundColor Green
    } else {
        Write-Warning "No master.env found at $SecretsFile"
    }
}

# Auto-load on every new PowerShell session
Load-AISecrets

# Helper: list what keys are loaded (hides values)
function Show-AIKeys {
    Get-ChildItem env: | Where-Object { 
        $_.Name -match 'API_KEY|TOKEN|SECRET|PASSWORD' 
    } | Select-Object Name, @{N='Value';E={'***'}}
} How Kimi Code uses it:

# Run this first. Do not proceed until we review the output.

$SearchRoots = @(
    "C:\Users\Dekan AI Brother\Desktop",
    "C:\Users\Dekan AI Brother\Projects",
    "C:\Users\Dekan AI Brother",
    "C:\Claude\Projects"
)

$SecretPatterns = @(
    'api[_-]?key\s*=\s*["\']?[a-zA-Z0-9_\-]{20,}["\']?',
    'api[_-]?secret\s*=\s*["\']?[a-zA-Z0-9_\-]{20,}["\']?',
    'token\s*=\s*["\']?[a-zA-Z0-9_\-]{20,}["\']?',
    'auth[_-]?token\s*=\s*["\']?[a-zA-Z0-9_\-]{20,}["\']?',
    'client[_-]?id\s*=\s*["\']?[a-zA-Z0-9_\-]{10,}["\']?',
    'client[_-]?secret\s*=\s*["\']?[a-zA-Z0-9_\-]{20,}["\']?',
    'password\s*=\s*["\']?[^"\'\s]{8,}["\']?',
    'connection[_-]?string\s*=\s*["\']?[^"\'\s]{10,}["\']?',
    'OPENROUTER_API_KEY',
    'GROQ_API_KEY',
    'AZURE_.*_KEY',
    'VERCEL_TOKEN',
    'GITHUB_TOKEN',
    'GH_TOKEN',
    'SUPABASE_.*',
    'DEEPGRAM_API_KEY',
    'DOC_INTEL_KEY'
)

$RepoMarkers = @('.git', 'package.json', 'requirements.txt', 'pyproject.toml', 'Cargo.toml', 'Dockerfile')

$Results = @()

foreach ($Root in $SearchRoots) {
    if (-not (Test-Path $Root)) { continue }
    
    # Find repos
    $Repos = Get-ChildItem -Path $Root -Directory -Recurse -Depth 2 | Where-Object {
        $RepoMarkers | ForEach-Object { Test-Path (Join-Path $_.FullName $_) } | Where-Object { $_ } | Select-Object -First 1
    }
    
    foreach ($Repo in $Repos) {
        $RepoResult = [PSCustomObject]@{
            RepoName = $Repo.Name
            RepoPath = $Repo.FullName
            HasGitHubRemote = $false
            GitHubRemote = $null
            SecretFiles = @()
            EnvFiles = @()
            HardcodedSecrets = @()
            ReferencedServices = @()
        }
        
        # Check GitHub remote
        $GitConfig = Join-Path $Repo.FullName ".git\config"
        if (Test-Path $GitConfig) {
            $RemoteUrl = (Select-String -Path $GitConfig -Pattern 'url\s*=\s*(https?://github\.com/.*)' | Select-Object -First 1).Matches.Groups[1].Value
            if ($RemoteUrl) {
                $RepoResult.HasGitHubRemote = $true
                $RepoResult.GitHubRemote = $RemoteUrl
            }
        }
        
        # Find .env, .env.local, .env.production, secrets.json, config.json
        $EnvFiles = Get-ChildItem -Path $Repo.FullName -File -Recurse | Where-Object { 
            $_.Name -match '^\.env' -or $_.Name -match 'secrets?' -or $_.Name -match 'config\.(json|yaml|yml)$'
        } | Select-Object -ExpandProperty FullName
        
        $RepoResult.EnvFiles = $EnvFiles
        
        # Scan for hardcoded secrets in code files
        $CodeFiles = Get-ChildItem -Path $Repo.FullName -File -Recurse | Where-Object {
            $_.Extension -in @('.py','.js','.ts','.jsx','.tsx','.ps1','.sh','.env','.json','.yaml','.yml','.toml')
        }
        
        foreach ($File in $CodeFiles) {
            $Content = Get-Content -Path $File.FullName -Raw -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
            if (-not $Content) { continue }
            
            foreach ($Pattern in $SecretPatterns) {
                $Matches = [regex]::Matches($Content, $Pattern, [System.Text.RegularExpressions.RegexOptions]::IgnoreCase)
                foreach ($Match in $Matches) {
                    $Masked = $Match.Value -replace '=["\']?([a-zA-Z0-9_\-]{4})[a-zA-Z0-9_\-]+["\']?$', '="****$1****"'
                    $RepoResult.HardcodedSecrets += "[{0}] {1}" -f $File.FullName.Replace($Repo.FullName, '.'), $Masked
                }
            }
            
            # Detect service references
            $Services = @(
                @{Name='OpenRouter'; Pattern='openrouter\.ai|OPENROUTER'},
                @{Name='Groq'; Pattern='groq\.com|GROQ'},
                @{Name='Azure'; Pattern='azure\.com|AZURE_|microsoft\.com/graph'},
                @{Name='Vercel'; Pattern='vercel\.com|VERCEL'},
                @{Name='Supabase'; Pattern='supabase\.co|SUPABASE'},
                @{Name='GitHub'; Pattern='github\.com|GITHUB_|GH_TOKEN'},
                @{Name='Deepgram'; Pattern='deepgram\.com|DEEPGRAM'},
                @{Name='OpenAI'; Pattern='openai\.com|OPENAI'},
                @{Name='P21'; Pattern='p21|prophet21|CISM'},
                @{Name='Runway'; Pattern='runwayml\.com|RUNWAY'},
                @{Name='Replicate'; Pattern='replicate\.com|REPLICATE'},
                @{Name='ElevenLabs'; Pattern='elevenlabs\.io|ELEVENLABS'}
            )
            
            foreach ($Svc in $Services) {
                if ($Content -match $Svc.Pattern -and $RepoResult.ReferencedServices -notcontains $Svc.Name) {
                    $RepoResult.ReferencedServices += $Svc.Name
                }
            }
        }
        
        $Results += $RepoResult
    }
}

# Output summary

# Path: $PROFILE (usually C:\Users\Dekan AI Brother\Documents\PowerShell\Microsoft.PowerShell_profile.ps1)

$Global:MasterSecretsPath = "$env:USERPROFILE\.ai-secrets\master.env"

function Load-AISecrets {
    param(
        [switch]$Silent,
        [string[]]$OnlyServices = @()  # e.g., @("openrouter", "github") to load subset
    )
    
    if (-not (Test-Path $Global:MasterSecretsPath)) {
        if (-not $Silent) { Write-Warning "No master.env found at $Global:MasterSecretsPath" }
        return $false
    }
    
    $Loaded = 0
    Get-Content $Global:MasterSecretsPath | ForEach-Object {
        # Skip comments and blank lines
        if ($_ -match '^\s*#' -or $_ -match '^\s*$') { return }
        
        if ($_ -match '^\s*([A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*)\s*=\s*(.*)\s*$') {
            $Key = $matches[1]
            $Value = $matches[2]
            
            # Skip empty values (not yet filled in)
            if ([string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($Value)) { return }
            
            [Environment]::SetEnvironmentVariable($Key, $Value, "Process")
            $Loaded++
        }
    }
    
    if (-not $Silent) {
        Write-Host "🔑 Loaded $Loaded secrets from master vault" -ForegroundColor Green
    }
    
    return $true
}

function Show-AIServices {
    $Services = @{}
    Get-ChildItem env: | Where-Object { $_.Name -match '_API_KEY$|_TOKEN$|_SECRET$|_PASSWORD$|_URL$' } | ForEach-Object {
        $Svc = $_.Name -replace '_.*', ''
        if (-not $Services[$Svc]) { $Services[$Svc] = @() }
        $Services[$Svc] += $_.Name
    }
    
    $Services.GetEnumerator() | Sort-Object Name | ForEach-Object {
        Write-Host "`n[$($_.Key)]" -ForegroundColor Cyan
        $_.Value | ForEach-Object { 
            $Val = (Get-Item "env:$_").Value
            $Masked = if ($Val.Length -gt 8) { $Val.Substring(0,4) + '****' + $Val.Substring($Val.Length-4) } else { '****' }
            Write-Host "  $_ = $Masked" 
        }
    }
}

function Get-AISecret {
    param([Parameter(Mandatory)][string]$Name)
    $Val = [Environment]::GetEnvironmentVariable($Name, "Process")
    if (-not $Val) { throw "Secret $Name not loaded. Check master.env" }
    return $Val
}

# Auto-load on every session
Load-AISecrets -Silent

    $targetFolder = switch -Regex ($ext) {

        '\.(md|txt|docx|pdf|one)$'  { 'notes' }
        '\.(py|js|ts|jsx|tsx|html|css|scss|json|yaml|yml|xml|sql|dockerfile|tf|hcl|ini|conf|env)$' { 'code' }

        '\.(log|out|err|trace)$'   { 'logs' }
        default                    { 'misc' }
    }

    $targetPath = Join-Path $dest $targetFolder
    $destFile = Join-Path $targetPath $item.Name

    # Handle duplicates by renaming
    if (Test-Path $destFile) {
        $baseName = [System.IO.Path]::GetFileNameWithoutExtension($item.Name)
        $extension = $item.Extension
        $counter = 1

            $destFile = Join-Path $targetPath $newName
            $counter++

        # Keep the first one, delete the rest
        $keeper = $instances[0]

            $dupFileCount = (Get-ChildItem -Path $dup.FullName -Recurse -File -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue).Count
            $dupDirCount = (Get-ChildItem -Path $dup.FullName -Recurse -Directory -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue).Count

    $targetFolder = $null

        } else {

    # 03-Notes → Notes\

        if ($relPath -like "03-notes\todo*") {

            $targetFolder = "Notes\from-downloads"

        }

    elseif ($relPath -like "06-backups*") {

            $targetFolder = "Tools\installers"
        } else {
            $targetFolder = "Archive"
        }
    }
    # 07-Shortcuts → Tools\shortcuts\
    elseif ($relPath -like "07-shortcuts*") {
        $targetFolder = "Tools\shortcuts"
    }
    # 08-Admin → Admin\
    elseif ($relPath -like "08-admin*") {
        if ($relPath -like "08-admin\api-inventory*") {
            $targetFolder = "Admin\api-inventory"

        } elseif ($relPath -like "08-admin\reviews*") {
            $targetFolder = "Admin\reviews"

            $targetFolder = "Admin\audits"
        } elseif ($relPath -like "08-admin\*music*") {
            $targetFolder = "Media\AudioProjects"
        } else {
            $targetFolder = "Admin"
        }
    }
    # Fallback by file type for anything not matching above
    else {
        $targetFolder = switch -Regex ($ext) {
            '\.(ps1|bat|cmd|sh|bash|zsh)$'      { 'Tools\scripts' }
            '\.(md|txt|docx|pdf|one|rtf|odt|epub)$'  { 'Notes' }
            '\.(py|js|ts|jsx|tsx|html|htm|css|scss|sass|less|json|yaml|yml|xml|sql|dockerfile|tf|hcl|ini|conf|config|env|gitignore|eslintrc|prettierrc|babelrc)$' { 'Archive\misc' }
            '\.(png|jpg|jpeg|gif|svg|webp|bmp|tiff|ico|raw|heic)$' { 'Media\Pictures' }
            '\.(mp4|mov|avi|webm|mkv|wmv)$' { 'Media\Videos' }
            '\.(mp3|wav|aac|flac|ogg|m4a)$' { 'Media\AudioProjects' }
            '\.(csv|xlsx|xls|parquet|db|sqlite|sqlite3|jsonl|ndjson|feather|orc)$' { 'Data\spreadsheets' }
            '\.(zip|tar|gz|tgz|rar|7z|iso|img|dmg|pkg|deb|rpm|appx|msi|exe|cab|msix)$' { 'Archive\zips' }
            '\.(log|out|err|trace|dbg)$'   { 'Admin\kimi-logs' }
            default                    { 'Archive\misc' }
        }
    }

    # Build target path
    $targetPath = Join-Path $dest $targetFolder
    $destFile = Join-Path $targetPath $fileName

    # Handle duplicates
    if (Test-Path $destFile) {
        $base = [System.IO.Path]::GetFileNameWithoutExtension($fileName)
        $extension = $item.Extension
        $counter = 1
        while (Test-Path $destFile) {
            $newName = "{0}_merged_{1:D2}{2}" -f $base, $counter, $extension
            $destFile = Join-Path $targetPath $newName
            $counter++
        }
        Write-Log "RENAME: $fileName -> $(Split-Path $destFile -Leaf) [$targetFolder]"
    } else {
        Write-Log "MOVE: $fileName -> $targetFolder"
    }

    # Execute move
    Move-Item -Path $item.FullName -Destination $destFile -Force
    $moved++
}

Full scope now:Merge TO be mergeed → already doneClean node_modules from whatever "New folder" on Desktop has themAudit that Desktop "New folder"Delete the 01-08 folders from DesktopDesktop final state: only audit reports for your working sessionsHere's the comprehensive prompt:powershell   Copy # === KIMI CODE PROMPT: DESKTOP CLEANUP SEQUENCE ===
# Target: C:\Users\Dekan AI Brother\Desktop
# Scope: Desktop ONLY. Merge already done. Home root untouched.
# Final state: Desktop = audit reports only
# ============================================================

$desktop = "C:\Users\Dekan AI Brother\Desktop"
$log = "C:\Users\Dekan AI Brother\Desktop\DESKTOP_CLEANUP_LOG.txt"

function Write-Log($msg) {
    $ts = Get-Date -Format "yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss"
    "$ts | $msg" | Tee-Object -FilePath $log -Append
}

Write-Log "=== DESKTOP CLEANUP SEQUENCE START ==="
Write-Log "Target: $desktop"
Write-Log ""

# --- PHASE 1: IDENTIFY WHAT'S ON DESKTOP ---
Write-Log "=== PHASE 1: DESKTOP INVENTORY ==="

$desktopItems = Get-ChildItem -Path $desktop -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
$folders = $desktopItems | Where-Object { $_.PSIsContainer }
$files = $desktopItems | Where-Object { !$_.PSIsContainer }

Write-Log "Desktop folders found: $($folders.Count)"
$folders | ForEach-Object { Write-Log "  📁 $($_.Name)" }

Write-Log "Desktop files found: $($files.Count)"
$files | ForEach-Object { 
    $sizeKB = [math]::Round($_.Length / 1KB, 1)
    Write-Log "  📄 $($_.Name) ($sizeKB KB)"
}

# --- PHASE 2: NUKE node_modules FROM DESKTOP FOLDERS ---
Write-Log "`n=== PHASE 2: CLEAN node_modules FROM DESKTOP ==="

$desktopNodeModules = Get-ChildItem -Path $desktop -Recurse -Directory -Filter "node_modules" -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
$nmDeleted = 0
$filesFreed = 0

foreach ($nm in $desktopNodeModules) {
    $fileCount = (Get-ChildItem -Path $nm.FullName -Recurse -File -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue).Count
    $filesFreed += $fileCount
    Write-Log "DELETING node_modules: $($nm.FullName) | $fileCount files"
    Remove-Item -Path $nm.FullName -Recurse -Force
    $nmDeleted++
}

Write-Log "node_modules folders deleted: $nmDeleted"
Write-Log "Files freed: $filesFreed"

# --- PHASE 3: AUDIT "NEW FOLDER" (or any large unsorted folder) ---
Write-Log "`n=== PHASE 3: AUDIT LARGE UNSORTED FOLDERS ==="

# Find folders > 500 MB or named "New folder"
$largeFolders = Get-ChildItem -Path $desktop -Directory -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Where-Object {
    $size = (Get-ChildItem -Path $_.FullName -Recurse -File -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Measure-Object -Property Length -Sum).Sum
    $sizeMB = $size / 1MB
    ($_.Name -like "*New folder*") -or ($sizeMB -gt 500)
} | Sort-Object { 
    (Get-ChildItem -Path $_.FullName -Recurse -File -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Measure-Object -Property Length -Sum).Sum 
} -Descending

foreach ($folder in $largeFolders) {
    $folderPath = $folder.FullName
    $folderName = $folder.Name
    $allFiles = Get-ChildItem -Path $folderPath -Recurse -File -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
    $allDirs = Get-ChildItem -Path $folderPath -Recurse -Directory -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
    $totalSize = ($allFiles | Measure-Object -Property Length -Sum).Sum
    $totalSizeMB = [math]::Round($totalSize / 1MB, 2)
    $totalSizeGB = [math]::Round($totalSize / 1GB, 2)

    Write-Log "`n--- AUDIT: $folderName ---"
    Write-Log "Path: $folderPath"
    Write-Log "Files: $($allFiles.Count) | Dirs: $($allDirs.Count) | Size: $totalSizeMB MB ($totalSizeGB GB)"

    # By type
    $byExt = @{}
    $byType = @{}
    foreach ($f in $allFiles) {
        $ext = $f.Extension.ToLower()
        $byExt[$ext] += 1
        $type = switch -Regex ($ext) {
            '\.(ps1|bat|cmd|sh)$' { 'scripts' }
            '\.(md|txt|docx|pdf)$' { 'notes' }
            '\.(js|ts|jsx|tsx|html|css|json|py)$' { 'code' }
            '\.(png|jpg|jpeg|gif|svg|webp|mp4|mov|mp3|wav)$' { 'media' }
            '\.(zip|tar|gz|rar|7z)$' { 'archives' }
            '\.(exe|msi|dmg|pkg)$' { 'installers' }
            default { 'misc' }
        }
        $byType[$type] += 1
    }

We need to audit first — identify what's an active project vs abandoned bloat.Here's a read-only audit prompt that maps every node_modules across your entire home folder, checks if it's a real project (has package.json, .git, recent activity), and flags what's safe to delete vs what must stay:powershell   Copy # === KIMI CODE PROMPT: SMART node_modules AUDIT — ENTIRE HOME FOLDER ===
# Target: C:\Users\Dekan AI Brother
# Mode: READ-ONLY — no files deleted, moved, or modified
# Output: Full map of every node_modules, project status, safe-to-delete flag
# ============================================================

$home = "C:\Users\Dekan AI Brother"
$log = "C:\Users\Dekan AI Brother\node_modules_AUDIT.txt"

function Write-Log($msg) {
    $ts = Get-Date -Format "yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss"
    "$ts | $msg" | Tee-Object -FilePath $log -Append
}

Write-Log "=== SMART node_modules AUDIT START ==="
Write-Log "Target: $home"
Write-Log "Mode: READ-ONLY"
Write-Log ""

# --- PHASE 1: FIND ALL node_modules ---
Write-Log "=== PHASE 1: SCANNING ALL node_modules ==="

$allNodeModules = Get-ChildItem -Path $home -Recurse -Directory -Filter "node_modules" -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
$nmCount = $allNodeModules.Count
Write-Log "Total node_modules found: $nmCount"

# --- PHASE 2: ANALYZE EACH node_modules ---
Write-Log "`n=== PHASE 2: PROJECT ANALYSIS PER node_modules ==="

$results = @()
$totalFiles = 0
$totalSize = 0

foreach ($nm in $allNodeModules) {
    $nmPath = $nm.FullName
    $nmParent = $nm.Parent.FullName
    $nmParentName = $nm.Parent.Name

    # Count files and size in this node_modules
    $files = Get-ChildItem -Path $nmPath -Recurse -File -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
    $fileCount = $files.Count
    $size = ($files | Measure-Object -Property Length -Sum).Sum
    $sizeMB = [math]::Round($size / 1MB, 2)
    $totalFiles += $fileCount
    $totalSize += $size

    # Check if parent is a real project
    $hasPackageJson = Test-Path (Join-Path $nmParent "package.json")
    $hasGit = Test-Path (Join-Path $nmParent ".git")
    $hasSrc = Test-Path (Join-Path $nmParent "src")
    $hasApp = Test-Path (Join-Path $nmParent "app")

    # Check recency of parent folder (any file modified in last 30 days?)
    $recentFiles = Get-ChildItem -Path $nmParent -Recurse -File -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Where-Object {
        $_.LastWriteTime -gt (Get-Date).AddDays(-30)
    }
    $isRecent = $recentFiles.Count -gt 0
    $recentCount = $recentFiles.Count

    # Check if parent is a known active project by name
    $activeKeywords = @("casa", "companion", "enpro", "epo", "crowdsource", "voice", "pipecat", "gce", "dekan", "active")
    $isLikelyActive = $false
    foreach ($kw in $activeKeywords) {
        if ($nmParentName.ToLower() -like "*$kw*") {
            $isLikelyActive = $true
            break
        }
    }

    # Determine recommendation
    $recommendation = "UNKNOWN"
    $reason = ""

    if ($hasPackageJson -and ($hasGit -or $hasSrc -or $hasApp) -and ($isRecent -or $isLikelyActive)) {
        $recommendation = "KEEP"
        $reason = "Active project: package.json + source + recent activity"
    }
    elseif ($hasPackageJson -and ($hasGit -or $hasSrc -or $hasApp) -and !$isRecent) {
        $recommendation = "REVIEW"
        $reason = "Stale project: has source but no recent activity"
    }
    elseif ($hasPackageJson -and !$hasGit -and !$hasSrc -and !$hasApp) {
        $recommendation = "DELETE"
        $reason = "No source code — likely downloaded dependency dump"
    }
    elseif (!$hasPackageJson) {
        $recommendation = "DELETE"
        $reason = "No package.json — orphaned node_modules"
    }
    elseif ($nmParentName -like "*Kimi_Agent*" -or $nmParentName -like "*download*" -or $nmParentName -like "*New folder*") {
        $recommendation = "DELETE"
        $reason = "Known download/abandoned folder"
    }
    else {
        $recommendation = "REVIEW"
        $reason = "Ambiguous — inspect manually"
    }

    $result = [PSCustomObject]@{
        node_modules_Path = $nmPath
        Parent_Name = $nmParentName
        Parent_Path = $nmParent
        Files = $fileCount
        Size_MB = $sizeMB
        Has_package_json = $hasPackageJson
        Has_git = $hasGit
        Has_src = $hasSrc
        Has_app = $hasApp
        Recent_Files_30d = $recentCount
        Is_Recent = $isRecent
        Is_Likely_Active = $isLikelyActive
        Recommendation = $recommendation
        Reason = $reason
    }

    $results += $result

    Write-Log "[$recommendation] $nmParentName | $fileCount files | $sizeMB MB | $reason"
}

# --- PHASE 3: SUMMARY BY RECOMMENDATION ---
Write-Log "`n=== PHASE 3: SUMMARY BY RECOMMENDATION ==="

$grouped = $results | Group-Object Recommendation
foreach ($g in $grouped) {
    $groupSize = ($g.Group | Measure-Object -Property Size_MB -Sum).Sum
    $groupFiles = ($g.Group | Measure-Object -Property Files -Sum).Sum
    Write-Log "$($g.Name): $($g.Count) locations | $groupFiles files | $([math]::Round($groupSize, 2)) MB"
}

# --- PHASE 4: TOP OFFENDERS (DELETE candidates) ---
Write-Log "`n=== PHASE 4: TOP DELETE CANDIDATES (by size) ==="

$deleteCandidates = $results | Where-Object { $_.Recommendation -eq "DELETE" } | Sort-Object Size_MB -Descending | Select-Object -First 20
foreach ($d in $deleteCandidates) {
    Write-Log "DELETE: $($d.Parent_Name) | $($d.Files) files | $($d.Size_MB) MB"
    Write-Log "  Path: $($d.Parent_Path)"
    Write-Log "  Reason: $($d.Reason)"
    Write-Log ""
}

# --- PHASE 5: ACTIVE PROJECTS TO KEEP ---
Write-Log "=== PHASE 5: ACTIVE PROJECTS (KEEP) ==="

$keepProjects = $results | Where-Object { $_.Recommendation -eq "KEEP" } | Sort-Object Size_MB -Descending
foreach ($k in $keepProjects) {
    Write-Log "KEEP: $($k.Parent_Name) | $($k.Files) files | $($k.Size_MB) MB"
    Write-Log "  Path: $($k.Parent_Path)"
    Write-Log "  Recent files (30d): $($k.Recent_Files_30d)"
    Write-Log ""
}

# --- PHASE 6: STALE PROJECTS NEEDING REVIEW ---
Write-Log "=== PHASE 6: STALE / REVIEW PROJECTS ==="

$reviewProjects = $results | Where-Object { $_.Recommendation -eq "REVIEW" } | Sort-Object Size_MB -Descending
foreach ($r in $reviewProjects) {
    Write-Log "REVIEW: $($r.Parent_Name) | $($r.Files) files | $($r.Size_MB) MB"
    Write-Log "  Path: $($r.Parent_Path)"
    Write-Log "  Reason: $($r.Reason)"
    Write-Log ""
}

# --- PHASE 7: GRAND TOTALS ---
$totalSizeMB = [math]::Round($totalSize / 1MB, 2)
$totalSizeGB = [math]::Round($totalSize / 1GB, 2)

Write-Log "=== GRAND TOTALS ==="
Write-Log "Total node_modules locations: $nmCount"
Write-Log "Total files in all node_modules: $totalFiles"
Write-Log "Total size: $totalSizeMB MB ($totalSizeGB GB)"

# --- PHASE 8: DESKTOP "NEW FOLDER" SPECIFIC AUDIT ---
Write-Log "`n=== PHASE 8: DESKTOP 'NEW FOLDER' AUDIT ==="

$newFolder = Join-Path $home "Desktop\New folder"
if (Test-Path $newFolder) {
    $nfFiles = Get-ChildItem -Path $newFolder -Recurse -File -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
    $nfDirs = Get-ChildItem -Path $newFolder -Recurse -Directory -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
    $nfSize = ($nfFiles | Measure-Object -Property Length -Sum).Sum
    $nfSizeMB = [math]::Round($nfSize / 1MB, 2)
    $nfSizeGB = [math]::Round($nfSize / 1GB, 2)

    Write-Log "New folder found: $newFolder"
    Write-Log "Files: $($nfFiles.Count) | Dirs: $($nfDirs.Count) | Size: $nfSizeMB MB ($nfSizeGB GB)"

    # Check for node_modules in New folder
    $nfNodeModules = $nfDirs | Where-Object { $_.Name -eq "node_modules" }
    if ($nfNodeModules) {
        foreach ($nfNm in $nfNodeModules) {
            $nfNmFiles = (Get-ChildItem -Path $nfNm.FullName -Recurse -File -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue).Count
            $nfNmSize = (Get-ChildItem -Path $nfNm.FullName -Recurse -File -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Measure-Object -Property Length -Sum).Sum
            $nfNmSizeMB = [math]::Round($nfNmSize / 1MB, 2)
            Write-Log "  node_modules found in New folder: $($nfNm.FullName) | $nfNmFiles files | $nfNmSizeMB MB"
        }
    }

    # Top-level items in New folder
    Write-Log "Top-level contents:"
    Get-ChildItem -Path $newFolder -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | ForEach-Object {
        if ($_.PSIsContainer) {
            $subSize = (Get-ChildItem -Path $_.FullName -Recurse -File -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Measure-Object -Property Length -Sum).Sum
            $subSizeMB = [math]::Round($subSize / 1MB, 2)
            Write-Log "  📁 $($_.Name) | $subSizeMB MB"
        } else {
            $fSizeMB = [math]::Round($_.Length / 1MB, 2)
            Write-Log "  📄 $($_.Name) | $fSizeMB MB"
        }
    }
} else {
    Write-Log "No 'New folder' found on Desktop"
}

Write-Log "`n=== AUDIT COMPLETE ==="
Write-Log "Log saved to: $log"

Write-Host "`n✅ Smart node_modules audit complete." -ForegroundColor Green
Write-Host "   Total node_modules: $nmCount" -ForegroundColor Cyan
Write-Host "   Total size: $totalSizeGB GB" -ForegroundColor Cyan
Write-Host "   Review log: $log" -ForegroundColor Yellow
Write-Host "`n⚠️  DO NOT DELETE ANYTHING YET." -ForegroundColor Red
Write-Host "   Review the KEEP/REVIEW/DELETE recommendations first." -ForegroundColor Red What this tells you:Table  Copy   CheckPurpose package.jsonIs this a real Node project or just a dumped folder?.git / src / appDoes it have source code and version control?Recent file activity (30d)Is someone actively working on it?Name keywordsDoes it match known active projects (casa, enpro, gce, etc.)?RecommendationKEEP (active), REVIEW (stale but real), DELETE (orphaned/bloat)Run this first.             elseif ($relPath -like "06-backups\installers*") { $targetFolder = "Tools\installers" }
            else { $targetFolder = "Archive" }
        }
        elseif ($relPath -like "07-shortcuts*") { $targetFolder = "Tools\shortcuts" }
        elseif ($relPath -like "08-admin*") {

            elseif ($relPath -like "08-admin\audits*") { $targetFolder = "Admin\audits" }
            elseif ($relPath -like "08-admin\*music*") { $targetFolder = "Media\AudioProjects" }
            else { $targetFolder = "Admin" }
        }
        else {
            $targetFolder = switch -Regex ($ext) {
                '\.(ps1|bat|cmd|sh|bash|zsh)$' { 'Tools\scripts' }
                '\.(md|txt|docx|pdf|one|rtf|odt|epub)$' { 'Notes' }
                '\.(py|js|ts|jsx|tsx|html|htm|css|scss|sass|less|json|yaml|yml|xml|sql|dockerfile|tf|hcl|ini|conf|config|env|gitignore|eslintrc|prettierrc|babelrc)$' { 'Archive\misc' }
                '\.(png|jpg|jpeg|gif|svg|webp|bmp|tiff|ico|raw|heic)$' { 'Media\Pictures' }
                '\.(mp4|mov|avi|webm|mkv|wmv)$' { 'Media\Videos' }
                '\.(mp3|wav|aac|flac|ogg|m4a)$' { 'Media\AudioProjects' }
                '\.(csv|xlsx|xls|parquet|db|sqlite|sqlite3|jsonl|ndjson|feather|orc)$' { 'Data\spreadsheets' }
                '\.(zip|tar|gz|tgz|rar|7z|iso|img|dmg|pkg|deb|rpm|appx|msi|exe|cab|msix)$' { 'Archive\zips' }
                '\.(log|out|err|trace|dbg)$' { 'Admin\kimi-logs' }
                default { 'Archive\misc' }
            }
        }

        $targetPath = Join-Path $home $targetFolder
        $destFile = Join-Path $targetPath $fileName

        if (Test-Path $destFile) {
            $base = [System.IO.Path]::GetFileNameWithoutExtension($fileName)
            $extension = $item.Extension
            $counter = 1
            while (Test-Path $destFile) {
                $newName = "{0}_merged_{1:D2}{2}" -f $base, $counter, $extension
                $destFile = Join-Path $targetPath $newName
                $counter++
            }
            Write-Log "RENAME: $fileName -> $(Split-Path $destFile -Leaf) [$targetFolder]"
        } else {
            Write-Log "MOVE: $fileName -> $targetFolder"
        }

        Move-Item -Path $item.FullName -Destination $destFile -Force
    }

    # Clean empty source dirs
    Get-ChildItem -Path $source -Recurse -Directory | Sort-Object {$_.FullName.Length} -Descending | ForEach-Object {
        if ((Get-ChildItem -Path $_.FullName -Recurse -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue).Count -eq 0) {
            Remove-Item $_.FullName -Force
        }
    }
    if ((Get-ChildItem -Path $source -Recurse -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue).Count -eq 0) {
        Remove-Item $source -Force -Recurse
        Write-Log "REMOVED: $source"
    }
}

foreach ($f in $numbered) {

    Remove-Item $f.FullName -Recurse -Force
}

# 7b: Delete everything else except audit reports
$allDesktop = Get-ChildItem -Path $desktop -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
foreach ($item in $allDesktop) {
    $name = $item.Name.ToLower()
    $isKeeper = $false
    foreach ($k in $keepers) {
        if ($name -like "*$k*") { $isKeeper = $true; break }
    }
    if (!$isKeeper) {
        if ($item.PSIsContainer) {
            Write-Log "DELETING: $($item.Name)"
        } else {
            Write-Log "DELETING: $($item.Name)"
        }
        Remove-Item $item.FullName -Recurse -Force
    } else {
        Write-Log "KEEPING: $($item.Name)"
    }
}

# ============================================================

$systemFiles = @('NTUSER.DAT', 'ntuser.dat.LOG1', 'ntuser.dat.LOG2', 'ntuser.ini', 'NTUSER.DAT{*')
$scriptExts = @('.ps1', '.py', '.js', '.bat', '.cmd', '.sh')

foreach ($item in $rootItems) {
    $isSystem = $false
    foreach ($sf in $systemFiles) {
        if ($item.Name -like $sf) { $isSystem = $true; break }
    }
    if ($isSystem) {
        Write-Log "KEEPING system file: $($item.Name)"
        continue
    }

    if ($scriptExts -contains $item.Extension.ToLower()) {
        $dest = Join-Path "$home\Tools\scripts" $item.Name
        if (Test-Path $dest) {
            $base = [System.IO.Path]::GetFileNameWithoutExtension($item.Name)
            $ext = $item.Extension
            $counter = 1
            while (Test-Path $dest) {
                $newName = "{0}_merged_{1:D2}{2}" -f $base, $counter, $ext
                $dest = Join-Path "$home\Tools\scripts" $newName
                $counter++
            }
        }
        Move-Item $item.FullName $dest -Force
        Write-Log "MOVE: $($item.Name) -> Tools\scripts\$(Split-Path $dest -Leaf)"
    }
    elseif ($item.Name -like "*audit*" -or $item.Name -like "*worktree*" -or $item.Name -like "*command_center*") {
        $dest = Join-Path "$home\Admin\audits" $item.Name
        if (Test-Path $dest) {
            $base = [System.IO.Path]::GetFileNameWithoutExtension($item.Name)
            $ext = $item.Extension
            $counter = 1
            while (Test-Path $dest) {
                $newName = "{0}_merged_{1:D2}{2}" -f $base, $counter, $ext
                $dest = Join-Path "$home\Admin\audits" $newName
                $counter++
            }
        }
        Move-Item $item.FullName $dest -Force
        Write-Log "MOVE: $($item.Name) -> Admin\audits\$(Split-Path $dest -Leaf)"
    }
    else {
        Write-Log "KEEPING root file: $($item.Name)"
    }
}

# ============================================================
Write-Log "`n=== PHASE 9: FINAL AUDIT ==="

$newTop = @('Projects', 'Tools', 'Notes', 'Data', 'Media', 'Archive', 'Admin', 'Config')
foreach ($folder in $newTop) {
    $path = Join-Path $home $folder
    if (Test-Path $path) {
        $files = (Get-ChildItem -Path $path -Recurse -File -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue).Count
        $size = (Get-ChildItem -Path $path -Recurse -File -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Measure-Object -Property Length -Sum).Sum
        $sizeMB = [math]::Round($size / 1MB, 2)
        Write-Log "[$folder] : $files files, $sizeMB MB"
    }
}

# Check Desktop
$desktopFiles = Get-ChildItem -Path $desktop -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
Write-Log "`nDesktop remaining: $($desktopFiles.Count) items"
$desktopFiles | ForEach-Object { Write-Log "  - $($_.Name)" }

# Check root

Write-Log "`nRoot loose files: $($rootRemaining.Count)"
$rootRemaining | ForEach-Object { Write-Log "  - $($_.Name)" }

# Check for old prefixed folders
$oldPrefixed = Get-ChildItem -Path $home -Directory -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Where-Object { $_.Name -match '^\d{2}-' }
Write-Log "`nOld prefixed folders remaining: $($oldPrefixed.Count)"
$oldPrefixed | ForEach-Object { Write-Log "  - $($_.Name)" }

Write-Log "`n=== REORGANIZATION COMPLETE ==="
Write-Log "Log saved to: $log"

Write-Host "`n✅ Full reorganization complete." -ForegroundColor Green
Write-Host "   Review log: $log" -ForegroundColor Yellow

└── 📄 README.md (MASTER DOCUMENTATION) 📄 README.md CONTENTMarkdown  Fullscreen  Download  Fit  Code Preview  # EPO CROWDSOURCE COMMAND CENTER
**European Patent Office Crowdsourced Data Analysis Project**

## 🎯 PROJECT OVERVIEW
Centralized repository for managing EPO patent data from crowdsourced contributions, 
API integrations, and analytical workflows.

## 📁 FOLDER STRUCTURE GUIDE

| Folder | Purpose | Access Level |
|--------|---------|-------------|
| 00_ADMIN | Project governance & management | Core Team Only |
| 01_DATA_SOURCES | Raw & processed EPO data | Data Managers |
| 02_CROWDSOURCE | Contributor workflows | All Contributors |
| 03_PATENT_DATA | Organized patent collections | Analysts |
| 04_ANALYSIS | Research & assessment outputs | Analysts |
| 05_COMMAND_CENTER | Dashboards, scripts, automation | Tech Team |
| 06_DOCUMENTATION | Standards, guides, references | All Users |
| 07_OUTPUTS | Reports & deliverables | Stakeholders |
| 08_ARCHIVE | Historical data & backups | Admin Only |
| 99_TEMPLATES | Standardized templates | All Users |

## 🔑 NAMING CONVENTIONS

### Folders
`[NUMBER]_[CATEGORY]_[SpecificName]`

### Files
`[YYYY-MM-DD]_[TYPE]_[Description]_[VERSION].[ext]`

Examples:
- `2026-06-14_OPS_Bibliographic_Download_v1.xml`
- `2026-06-14_Task_PriorArt_Review_EP123456.md`

## 🌐 DATA SOURCES

### Primary: EPO Open Patent Services (OPS)
- API Version: 3.2
- Base URL: https://ops.epo.org/3.2/rest-services
- Authentication: OAuth2 (Consumer Key + Secret)
- Quota: 4 GB/week (non-paying) / 2.5 GB/week (fair use)

### Secondary Sources
- Espacenet (search interface)
- PATSTAT (statistical database)
- USPTO, WIPO, Google Patents (cross-referencing)

## 👥 CROWDSOURCE WORKFLOW

1. **Onboarding**: Contributors complete training in 02a
2. **Task Assignment**: Active tasks distributed from 02b
3. **Data Entry**: Input following standards in 06b
4. **Validation**: Peer review in 02c, then expert review
5. **Integration**: Validated data moves to 03_PATENT_DATA
6. **Analysis**: Analysts process in 04_ANALYSIS
7. **Reporting**: Outputs generated in 07_OUTPUTS

## ⚙️ COMMAND CENTER OPERATIONS

### Automation Scripts
- `ops_api_client.py` - EPO API interface
- `data_parser.py` - XML/JSON conversion
- `batch_processor.py` - Bulk data handling

### Monitoring
- API quota usage tracked in 01a/05d
- Data quality flags in 05d
- Contributor activity in 05a

## 🔒 SECURITY & COMPLIANCE

- EPO API credentials stored in `.env` (never commit)
- GDPR compliance for contributor data
- Data retention: 7 years for patent records
- Backup schedule: Daily incremental, weekly full

## 📊 QUALITY STANDARDS

- All data entries require source attribution
- XML validation against EPO schema
- Cross-reference verification mandatory
- Duplicate detection automated

## 🚀 QUICK START

1. Clone repository
2. Copy `99_TEMPLATES` for new work
3. Configure API credentials in `01a/configs/`
4. Review `06a/API_Documentation/`
5. Join active task in `02b/`

## 📞 CONTACT

- Project Lead: [Name]
- Data Manager: [Name]
- Tech Lead: [Name]
- EPO Liaison: [Name]

Here's what you're probably not doing and why it matters.The Core Problem You're FacingRight now you're probably doing this:One local clone per repoSwitching branches inside that single folderStashing work when you need to hotfix somethingMaybe multiple full clones eating disk spaceAgents (Kimi, Claude, etc.) all stepping on each other in the same working directoryWorktrees fix this. They let you have multiple working directories (full checkouts) tied to a single Git repository. Same .git object store, different branches checked out simultaneously in different folders. No stashing, no "oh shit I was in the middle of something," no clone bloat. The Proper Setup: Bare Clone + WorktreesThis is the pattern the pnpm team and serious agent orchestrators use. Step 1: Bare clone as your hubpowershell   Copy # Create a hub directory
mkdir C:\Claude\Projects\casa-companion-hub
cd C:\Claude\Projects\casa-companion-hub

# Bare clone (no working files, just Git data)
git clone --bare https://github.com/GCEstack/gce-ai-casa-companion.git casa-companion.git
cd casa-companion.git Step 2: Create worktrees as siblingspowershell   Copy # Main branch always checked out
git worktree add ../main main

# Feature work for you
git worktree add -b feature/hero-video ../feature-hero main

# Agent isolation—Kimi Code works here
git worktree add -b agent/kimi-audit ../agent-kimi main

# Hotfix branch ready to go
git worktree add -b hotfix/api-timeout ../hotfix-api main Resulting structure:plain   Copy casa-companion-hub/
├── casa-companion.git/     # Bare repo (shared Git objects)
├── main/                   # Your stable main checkout
├── feature-hero/           # Your feature work
├── agent-kimi/             # Kimi Code agent workspace
└── hotfix-api/             # Emergency fixes Each folder is a full working directory with its own branch, its own files, its own node_modules if needed. But they all share the same underlying Git history—so disk usage is minimal. Why This Matters for Your Agent WorkflowYou run Kimi Code, Claude Code, Cursor, whatever. Without worktrees, they're all fighting over the same files or you're cloning the repo 4 times. With worktrees:Kimi Code gets ../agent-kimi — it can edit, build, break things without touching your main workClaude Code gets ../agent-claude — parallel work on a different featureYou stay in ../main or ../feature-hero — your context is preservedCompare implementations side-by-side in your IDE: code ../feature-hero ../agent-kimi The pnpm team literally uses this for "AI-assisted development" — they spin up worktrees per agent task. The Pre-Warmed Pool Pattern (Critical for Speed)Here's where you probably get fucked: creating a worktree is instant, but npm install / pnpm install is NOT. If every agent spin-up costs you a 10-minute dependency install, you won't use worktrees for small tasks. The fix: Keep a pool of "warm" worktrees with dependencies already installed.powershell   Copy # Create 3 warm slots
git worktree add ../slot-a main
git worktree add ../slot-b main
git worktree add ../slot-c main

# Install deps in each (one-time cost)
cd ../slot-a && pnpm install
cd ../slot-b && pnpm install
cd ../slot-c && pnpm install When an agent needs to work:Grab a warm slotgit pull origin main (fast)git checkout -b agent/task-123 (instant)Work, commit, pushgit checkout main && git pull to reset the slot for next timeIf lockfile changed, reinstall. Otherwise, near-instant agent spin-up. What You're Missing: Environment ManagementYou mentioned Vercel deploy from GitHub. That's fine. But the branch-per-environment model (dev branch, staging branch, prod branch) is an anti-pattern for GitOps. Don't do this:main → productionstaging → staging branchdev → dev branchMerging between them for "promotion"Why it breaks: A merge from staging to prod doesn't just bring your code—it brings every config tweak, replica count change, environment variable someone tweaked in staging. You end up with "configuration drift" and merge conflicts that have nothing to do with your actual feature. Do this instead:One branch: main (trunk-based development)Vercel Preview Deployments for every PR (automatic)Production deploys from tagged releases on main, not branch mergesEnvironment-specific config lives in Vercel dashboard / Azure Key Vault / .env.production, NOT in Git branchesYour Git history stays clean. Your deploys are deterministic. Your agents aren't confused about which branch is "real."The Missing Pieces in Your Current SetupTable  Copy   What You HaveWhat's MissingWhy It Matters GitHub repoBare clone + worktree hubParallel agent work without conflictVercel deployPre-warmed worktree poolAgent spin-up in seconds, not minutesBranch switchingPer-feature worktreesNo stashing, no lost contextSingle local cloneSubmodule-aware worktreesIf you use submodules (you might), each worktree needs its submodules initialized separately Manual agent managementWorktree naming convention (agent/kimi-*, feature/*, hotfix/*)Clean up automation, know what's whatPowerShell Script to Set This UpHere's a Kimi Code-ready prompt to implement this for any of your repos:powershell   Copy # === KIMI CODE PROMPT: SETUP WORKTREE HUB ===

## Per-Repo Steps (repeat for each)

1. **Check current repo status**
   - `cd` into the existing repo folder
   - Run `git remote -v` to find the origin URL
   - Run `git branch -a` to see available branches
   - Check if `.git` folder exists (if not, skip)
   - Report: "Repo [name] has remote [url], branches [list]"

2. **Create hub folder**
   - Path: same parent as the repo, named `[repo-name]-hub`
   - Example: `C:\Users\Dekan AI Brother\Projects\01_ACTIVE\apps-platforms\casa-companion-hub`
   - Do NOT proceed if the existing repo folder is missing

3. **Bare clone**
   - `git clone --bare <origin-url> [repo-name].git`
   - OR if no remote: `git clone --bare <local-path> [repo-name].git`

4. **Configure bare repo**
   - `cd [repo-name].git`
   - `git config remote.origin.fetch "+refs/heads/*:refs/remotes/origin/*"`
   - `git fetch origin` (or `git fetch` if local-only)

5. **Create worktrees**
   - `git worktree add ../main main` (or default branch)
   - `git worktree add -b agent/kimi-audit ../agent-kimi main`
   - `git worktree add -b agent/claude-review ../agent-claude main`
   - `git worktree add -b feature/active-work ../feature-active main`

6. **Verify**
   - `git worktree list`
   - Report the full output

7. **Confirm with me**
   - Ask: "Repo [name] hub is ready. Move to next repo: [name]?"
   - Wait for my "yes" before proceeding

## Sacred Code Rules (NEVER TOUCH)
These files/patterns are OFF LIMITS for any agent modification:
- Any file containing `DATABASE_URL`, `SUPABASE_URL`, `SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY`
- Any file with `AZURE_OPENAI_KEY`, `AZURE_OPENAI_ENDPOINT`, `OPENAI_API_KEY`

- Database schema files (`schema.sql`, `migrations/`, `prisma/schema.prisma` if exists)

### 3. Backend Review
- API framework (FastAPI? Express? Next.js API routes?)
- Database (Supabase? Postgres? other?)
- AI provider integration pattern
- Voice/realtime implementation
- Deployment target

### 4. Security Audit
- Client-side API keys (check all `.env.example` files)
- Hardcoded credentials in source
- `.env.production` or `.env` files not in `.gitignore`
- Supabase keys exposed
- OpenAI/Deepgram keys in browser bundle

### 5. Deployment & Config
- Vercel connection status
- GitHub push status (is local ahead of remote?)
- Azure container app status (if applicable)
- Build scripts and CI/CD

### 6. Issues & Opportunities
- What's broken?
- What's missing?
- What's duplicated?
- What should be consolidated?
- Recommended next actions (prioritized)

- `git fetch gcestack`
- `git log gcestack/main --oneline -5` (or gcestack/master)
- Report: last 5 commits on GCEstack

### 3. Compare
- `git log --oneline --left-right --graph local/main...gcestack/main`
- Count commits ahead (local has newer) vs behind (GCEstack has newer)
- Report:

  - GCEstack ahead by Y commits
  - Any merge conflicts expected?

### 4. Decision
Report per repo:
- **"Local is newer"** → push local to GCEstack
- **"GCEstack is newer"** → pull from GCEstack first
- **"Diverged"** → needs manual merge review
- **"Identical"** → no action needed

### 5. Clean up
- `git remote remove gcestack` (remove temporary remote)

It's locked on by design.Here's the breakdown from the official docs:K2.7-Code = Thinking Always OnKimi K2.7-Code is purpose-built as a coding agent model. Moonshot made thinking mode mandatory — disabling it returns an API error. The model is architected to always reason before acting. If you try to pass thinking: disabled via the API, it errors out. Same in Kimi Code CLI — if you toggle thinking off, the request automatically falls back to K2.6 instead. What You CAN Do1. Switch to K2.6 for instant modeK2.6 supports thinking: disabled via API (extra_body: {"thinking": {"type": "disabled"}})In Kimi Code CLI, disable thinking in your config.toml:toml   Copy [thinking]
mode = "off" This forces K2.6 to handle non-thinking requests. 2. Reduce thinking effort in K2.7-Code
In your config.toml, you can dial down the depth:toml   Copy [thinking]
mode = "on"          # locked on for K2.7-Code
effort = "low"       # options: low, medium, high, xhigh, max This won't kill thinking entirely, but it'll use fewer reasoning tokens (Moonshot claims ~30% lower than K2.6 already). 3. Wait for the High-Speed Edition
Docs mention a K2.7-Code High-Speed Edition (beta coming soon) at ~5-6× output speed — same model, faster inference. Bottom LineIf you need zero-thinking / instant responses for simple tasks, route those to K2.6. Keep K2.7-Code for the heavy agentic coding work where the reasoning actually pays off. The thinking overhead is the tradeoff for the long-horizon coding performance gains. # --- CREATE MODEL-SPECIFIC CONFIGS (run once) ---
function Initialize-KimiConfigs {
    if (-not (Test-Path $KimiConfigDir)) {
        New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $KimiConfigDir -Force | Out-Null
    }

    # K2.6 — Fast, No Thinking
    if (-not (Test-Path $K26Config)) {
        @"
[model]
name = "kimi-k2-6"

[thinking]
mode = "off"
"@ | Set-Content $K26Config -Encoding UTF8
        Write-Host "Created K2.6 config" -ForegroundColor Green
    }

    # K2.7-Code — Deep Agent Mode
    if (-not (Test-Path $K27Config)) {
        @"
[model]
name = "kimi-k2-7-code"

[thinking]
mode = "on"
effort = "medium"

[agent]
max_iterations = 50
auto_run = true
"@ | Set-Content $K27Config -Encoding UTF8
        Write-Host "Created K2.7-Code config" -ForegroundColor Yellow
    }
}

# --- SWAP CONFIG HELPER ---
function Switch-KimiConfig {
    param([string]$Model)
    
    if (-not (Test-Path $KimiConfigPath)) {
        Write-Error "No base config.toml found at $KimiConfigPath"
        return $false
    }

    # Backup current if not already backed up
    if (-not (Test-Path $K27Backup)) {
        Copy-Item $KimiConfigPath $K27Backup -Force
    }

    $targetConfig = if ($Model -eq "k26") { $K26Config } else { $K27Config }
    Copy-Item $targetConfig $KimiConfigPath -Force
    return $true
}

function Restore-KimiConfig {
    if (Test-Path $K27Backup) {
        Copy-Item $K27Backup $KimiConfigPath -Force
    }
}

# --- MAIN FUNCTIONS ---

function kimi26 {
    <#
    .SYNOPSIS
        Run Kimi Code with K2.6 (fast, no thinking). Use for: simple refactors, 
        file searches, grep-style tasks, quick edits, linting, formatting.
    .EXAMPLE
        kimi26 "find all console.log statements in this repo"
        kimi26 "format this python file with black"
        k6 "review this README for typos"
    #>
    param(
        [Parameter(ValueFromRemainingArguments=$true)]
        [string[]]$Args
    )

    Initialize-KimiConfigs

    if ($Args.Count -eq 0) {
        Write-Host "K2.6 mode ready. Usage: kimi26 <prompt>" -ForegroundColor Cyan
        Write-Host "  Fast, no thinking. Good for: search, format, lint, simple edits." -ForegroundColor Gray
        return
    }

    $swapped = Switch-KimiConfig -Model "k26"
    if (-not $swapped) { return }

    $argString = $Args -join " "
    Write-Host ">>> [K2.6 — FAST] $argString" -ForegroundColor Green

    try {
        kimi $argString
    }
    finally {
        Restore-KimiConfig
        Write-Host "<<< Restored K2.7-Code config" -ForegroundColor DarkGray
    }
}

function kimi27 {
    <#
    .SYNOPSIS
        Run Kimi Code with K2.7-Code (thinking ON, agent mode). Use for: complex 
        architecture, debugging, multi-file refactors, system design, deep reasoning.
    .EXAMPLE
        kimi27 "refactor auth system to JWT with refresh tokens across 5 files"
        kimi27 "debug why this async pipeline is hanging and fix it"
        k7 "design a new caching layer with Redis fallback"
    #>
    param(
        [Parameter(ValueFromRemainingArguments=$true)]
        [string[]]$Args
    )

    Initialize-KimiConfigs

    if ($Args.Count -eq 0) {
        Write-Host "K2.7-Code mode ready. Usage: kimi27 <prompt>" -ForegroundColor Cyan
        Write-Host "  Thinking ON, agent mode. Good for: architecture, debug, multi-step coding." -ForegroundColor Gray
        return
    }

    $swapped = Switch-KimiConfig -Model "k27"
    if (-not $swapped) { return }

    $argString = $Args -join " "
    Write-Host ">>> [K2.7-CODE — THINKING] $argString" -ForegroundColor Yellow

    try {
        kimi $argString
    }
    finally {
        Restore-KimiConfig
        Write-Host "<<< Restored K2.7-Code config" -ForegroundColor DarkGray
    }
}

function kimi-status {
    <#
    .SYNOPSIS
        Check current Kimi Code model and thinking status.
    #>
    Write-Host "`n=== KIMI CODE STATUS ===" -ForegroundColor Cyan
    
    if (Test-Path $KimiConfigPath) {
        $content = Get-Content $KimiConfigPath -Raw
        $model = if ($content -match 'name\s*=\s*"([^"]+)"') { $matches[1] } else { "unknown" }
        $thinking = if ($content -match 'mode\s*=\s*"([^"]+)"') { $matches[1] } else { "unknown" }
        
        Write-Host "  Active Config: $KimiConfigPath" -ForegroundColor White
        Write-Host "  Model:         $model" -ForegroundColor White
        Write-Host "  Thinking:      $thinking" -ForegroundColor White
    }
    else {
        Write-Host "  No config.toml found at $KimiConfigPath" -ForegroundColor Red
    }

    Write-Host "`n  Aliases:" -ForegroundColor Cyan
    Write-Host "    k6  -> kimi26 (K2.6, fast, no thinking)" -ForegroundColor Green
    Write-Host "    k7  -> kimi27 (K2.7-Code, thinking ON)" -ForegroundColor Yellow
    Write-Host "    ks  -> kimi-status" -ForegroundColor White
    Write-Host "========================`n" -ForegroundColor Cyan
}

        stream = if ($NoStream) { $false } else { $true }
        temperature = 0.1

# 1. CONFIGURATION
$WorkspaceRoot = "C:\Users\Dekan AI Brother\Projects\ACTIVE\apps-platforms\EC4"
$Now = Get-Date

# Time thresholds
$24HoursAgo = $Now.AddHours(-24)
$48HoursAgo = $Now.AddHours(-48)

# Target folders (create if missing)
$Folders = @{
    "Excel"       = Join-Path $WorkspaceRoot "01-Excel"
    "Text"        = Join-Path $WorkspaceRoot "02-Text"
    "Docs"        = Join-Path $WorkspaceRoot "03-Documents"
    "Media"       = Join-Path $WorkspaceRoot "04-Media"
    "Scripts"     = Join-Path $WorkspaceRoot "05-Scripts"
    "Archives"    = Join-Path $WorkspaceRoot "99-Archive"
    "Loose"       = Join-Path $WorkspaceRoot "00-Loose-Recent"
}

# Create all folders
$Folders.Values | ForEach-Object { New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $_ -Force | Out-Null }

# File type mappings
$TypeMap = @{
    ".xlsx" = "Excel"; ".xls" = "Excel"; ".csv" = "Excel"
    ".txt"  = "Text"; ".md" = "Text"; ".json" = "Text"; ".xml" = "Text"; ".yaml" = "Text"; ".yml" = "Text"
    ".docx" = "Docs"; ".doc" = "Docs"; ".pdf" = "Docs"
    ".png"  = "Media"; ".jpg" = "Media"; ".jpeg" = "Media"; ".gif" = "Media"; ".mp4" = "Media"; ".mov" = "Media"; ".webp" = "Media"
    ".ps1"  = "Scripts"; ".bat" = "Scripts"; ".cmd" = "Scripts"; ".sh" = "Scripts"; ".py" = "Scripts"
    ".zip"  = "Archives"; ".rar" = "Archives"; ".7z" = "Archives"; ".tar" = "Archives"; ".gz" = "Archives"
}

# 2. SCAN & CLASSIFY
$Items = Get-ChildItem -Path $WorkspaceRoot -Depth 0 | Where-Object { 
    $_.FullName -notin $Folders.Values 
}

$Report = @()
$MovedCount = 0

foreach ($Item in $Items) {
    $LastAccess = $Item.LastAccessTime
    $Ext = if ($Item.Extension) { $Item.Extension.ToLower() } else { "" }
    $IsFolder = $Item.PSIsContainer
    $TypeLabel = if ($IsFolder) { "FOLDER" } else { "FILE" }
    
    # Determine destination
    $DestFolder = $null
    
    if ($IsFolder) {
        # Folders: check if loose (not in our structure)
        if ($LastAccess -lt $48HoursAgo) {
            $DestFolder = $Folders["Archives"]
        } elseif ($LastAccess -lt $24HoursAgo) {
            $DestFolder = $Folders["Archives"]  # Or proper subfolder if known
        } else {
            $DestFolder = $Folders["Loose"]
        }
    } else {
        # Files: route by type + age
        $BaseDest = if ($TypeMap.ContainsKey($Ext)) { 
            $Folders[$TypeMap[$Ext]] 
        } else { 
            $Folders["Loose"] 
        }
        
        if ($LastAccess -lt $48HoursAgo) {
            $DestFolder = Join-Path $Folders["Archives"] (Split-Path $BaseDest -Leaf)
            New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $DestFolder -Force | Out-Null
        } elseif ($LastAccess -lt $24HoursAgo) {
            $DestFolder = $BaseDest
        } else {
            $DestFolder = $Folders["Loose"]
        }
    }
    
    # Execute move
    $DestPath = Join-Path $DestFolder $Item.Name
    $Conflict = Test-Path $DestPath
    
    if ($Conflict) {
        $Timestamp = Get-Date -Format "yyyyMMdd-HHmmss"
        $NewName = "{0}_{1}{2}" -f $Item.BaseName, $Timestamp, $Item.Extension
        $DestPath = Join-Path $DestFolder $NewName
    }
    
    Move-Item -Path $Item.FullName -Destination $DestPath -Force
    
    $Report += [PSCustomObject]@{
        Name        = $Item.Name
        Type        = $TypeLabel
        LastAccess  = $LastAccess
        Destination = $DestFolder
        Renamed     = $Conflict
    }
    
    $MovedCount++
}

# 3. CLEANUP EMPTY LOOSE FOLDERS (optional)
Get-ChildItem -Path $WorkspaceRoot -Directory -Recurse | 
    Where-Object { $_.GetFiles().Count -eq 0 -and $_.GetDirectories().Count -eq 0 } |
    Remove-Item -Force

# 4. REPORT
Write-Host "`n=== EC4 WORKSPACE CLEANUP COMPLETE ===" -ForegroundColor Green
Write-Host "Items processed: $MovedCount" -ForegroundColor Cyan
Write-Host "`nFolder structure:" -ForegroundColor Yellow
Get-ChildItem -Path $WorkspaceRoot -Directory | ForEach-Object {
    $Count = (Get-ChildItem -Path $_.FullName -Recurse -File).Count
    Write-Host "  $($_.Name): $Count items"
}

Write-Host "`nDetailed log saved to: " -NoNewline
$LogPath = Join-Path $WorkspaceRoot "cleanup-log-$(Get-Date -Format 'yyyyMMdd-HHmmss').json"
$Report | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 3 | Out-File -FilePath $LogPath
Write-Host $LogPath -ForegroundColor Magenta

# 5. SUMMARY TABLE

}
$Dirs.Values | ForEach-Object { New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $_ -Force | Out-Null }

# --- 3. FILE TYPE MAP ---
$Map = @{
    ".xlsx"=".xls"=".csv"="01-Excel"
    ".txt"=".md"=".json"=".xml"=".yaml"=".yml"=".log"="02-Text"
    ".docx"=".doc"=".pdf"=".pptx"=".ppt"="03-Docs"

$Log = @()

foreach ($Item in $Items) {

    $Ext = ($Item.Extension).ToLower()
    $IsDir = $Item.PSIsContainer

    if ($Age -ge $24h) {

    if ($IsDir -and $Age -lt $48h -and $Age -lt $24h) { $Bucket = "00-Recent" }

        Destination = $Target

## Kimi Work Scheduler Integration
- Account: account1
- Created: 2026-07-03T02:41:15Z

**User:** Is there a way I could schedule tasks from Kimi app on my phone or the Kimi desktop to when we create things power show will pick up those task in the work session and run them

**Assistant:** Search Kimi AI schedule tasks PowerShell automation Kimi Code PowerShell integration task scheduling Kimi AI agent scheduled execution workflow  22 results    Yes, absolutely. The bridge between Kimi (app/desktop) and PowerShell execution is Kimi Work — the desktop local agent — which has a built-in Cron scheduler and can execute shell/Python tasks on your machine. Here's how to wire it up:The ArchitectureKimi Work (Desktop) → Cron Scheduler → PowerShell Script → Your Work SessionKimi Work runs locally, mounts your folders, and has a Cron engine that can trigger LLM agent calls, Python executions, or shell commands at scheduled intervals. It also supports "Keep Computer Awake" for overnight tasks. Two Ways to Set This UpOption 1: Kimi Work Native Cron (Recommended)Kimi Work has a built-in scheduler that supports:LLM Agent Calls — Trigger a Kimi agent to run a specific taskPython/Shell executions — Run PowerShell scripts directlyConditional triggers — Daily, hourly, or custom intervalsHow to configure:Open Kimi Work desktop appCreate a Skill (reusable instruction package) that defines what PowerShell should doUse the Cron scheduler to set when it runs (e.g., daily at 8 AM, or every 4 hours)Toggle "Keep Computer Awake" if you need overnight executionThe agent executes quietly in the background and writes outputs to your local foldersExample Skill prompt for PowerShell execution:plain   Copy Run PowerShell script at C:\Users\Dekan AI Brother\scripts\daily-sync.ps1
Capture output to C:\Users\Dekan AI Brother\logs\sync-$(Get-Date -Format yyyyMMdd).log
If errors occur, summarize them and save to error-log.txt Option 2: Windows Task Scheduler + Kimi Work BridgeIf you want more granular Windows-native control, use Task Scheduler to kick off PowerShell, but have Kimi Work generate/maintain the scripts:powershell   Copy # === KIMI WORK → POWERSHELL SCHEDULER ===
# Save this as: C:\Users\Dekan AI Brother\scripts\kimi-task-runner.ps1

param(
    [string]$TaskName = "default",
    [string]$WorkingDir = "C:\Users\Dekan AI Brother\",
    [string]$LogDir = "C:\Users\Dekan AI Brother\logs\"
)

$timestamp = Get-Date -Format "yyyy-MM-dd_HH-mm"
$logFile = Join-Path $LogDir "kimi-task-$TaskName-$timestamp.log"

# Create log directory if missing
New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path $LogDir | Out-Null

# Write header
"=== KIMI TASK: $TaskName | $(Get-Date) ===" | Out-File $logFile -Append

# Your task logic here - this is what Kimi Work would generate/update
switch ($TaskName) {
    "repo-scan" {
        # Example: scan your repos
        "Running repo scan..." | Out-File $logFile -Append
        # Add your actual commands
    }
    "casa-companion-deploy" {
        "Deploying Casa Companion updates..." | Out-File $logFile -Append
    }
    "epo-crowdsource-sync" {
        "Syncing EPO Crowdsource..." | Out-File $logFile -Append
    }
    default {
        "No task handler for: $TaskName" | Out-File $logFile -Append
    }
}

"=== COMPLETED: $(Get-Date) ===" | Out-File $logFile -Append Then register it with Windows Task Scheduler:powershell   Copy # === REGISTER SCHEDULED TASK ===
$action = New-ScheduledTaskAction `
    -Execute "powershell.exe" `
    -Argument "-NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File `"C:\Users\Dekan AI Brother\scripts\kimi-task-runner.ps1`" -TaskName `"repo-scan`""

$trigger = New-ScheduledTaskTrigger -Daily -At 8am

$principal = New-ScheduledTaskPrincipal `
    -UserId "$env:USERDOMAIN\$env:USERNAME" `
    -LogonType Interactive `
    -RunLevel Highest

$settings = New-ScheduledTaskSettingsSet `
    -AllowStartIfOnBatteries `
    -DontStopIfGoingOnBatteries `
    -StartWhenAvailable

Register-ScheduledTask `
    -TaskName "KimiWork-RepoScan" `
    -Action $action `
    -Trigger $trigger `
    -Principal $principal `
    -Settings $settings `
    -Description "Kimi Work scheduled task - runs PowerShell script for repo scanning" The Workflow LoopYou create/schedule tasks in Kimi (app or desktop) — describe what you want doneKimi Work generates the PowerShell script and saves it to your scripts folderKimi Work Cron or Windows Task Scheduler picks it up at the scheduled timePowerShell runs it — writes logs, modifies files, deploys to Azure, etc.Next Kimi session — you or the AI reads the logs and continues from where it left offKimi Code IntegrationSince you use Kimi Code in PowerShell already, you can have the scheduled task invoke Kimi Code directly:powershell   Copy # In your scheduled script, call Kimi Code for autonomous execution
kimi --session "nightly-tasks" --yolo "Review C:\Users\Dekan AI Brother\runway\ for any new images, generate videos using the hero pipeline, and save to the videos folder. Log all actions." This uses Kimi Code's session persistence (--session) and auto-approval (--yolo) for fully hands-off execution. Bottom LineKimi Work desktop is the missing link. It has the scheduler, it runs locally, it can execute PowerShell, and it maintains context across sessions. You schedule tasks in natural language, Kimi Work translates that to PowerShell, and your Windows machine runs them on autopilot.Want me to build out the full PowerShell scaffold for your specific projects (Casa Companion, EPO, edge-crew) with the task definitions and scheduler registration?                                       Reference             Yes, please

function Write-Audit {
    param([string]$msg)
    $timestamp = Get-Date -Format "yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss"
    "$timestamp | $msg" | Tee-Object -FilePath $auditLog -Append
}

            } catch {}

            $branches = 0

            } catch {}
            
            $AllRepos += [PSCustomObject]@{

                RemoteUrl = $remote

Write-Host "`n🔍 PHASE 2: Analyzing similar names and duplicates..." -ForegroundColor Cyan

# Group by exact name

# Fuzzy similarity detection (Levenshtein-style simple matching)
function Get-SimilarityScore {
    param([string]$s1, [string]$s2)
    $s1 = $s1.ToLower().Replace("-","").Replace("_","").Replace(" ","")
    $s2 = $s2.ToLower().Replace("-","").Replace("_","").Replace(" ","")
    
    if ($s1 -eq $s2) { return 100 }
    if ($s1.Contains($s2) -or $s2.Contains($s1)) { return 85 }
    
    # Simple character overlap
    $set1 = $s1.ToCharArray() | Sort-Object -Unique
    $set2 = $s2.ToCharArray() | Sort-Object -Unique
    $intersection = ($set1 | Where-Object { $set2 -contains $_ }).Count
    $union = ($set1 + $set2 | Sort-Object -Unique).Count
    return [math]::Round(($intersection / $union) * 100)
}

    for ($j = $i + 1; $j -lt $AllRepos.Count; $j++) {
        if ($processed -contains $j) { continue }
        
        $score = Get-SimilarityScore $AllRepos[$i].Name $AllRepos[$j].Name
        if ($score -ge 70) {
            $group += $AllRepos[$j]
            $processed += $j
        }
    }
    
    if ($group.Count -gt 1) {
        $SimilarGroups += [PSCustomObject]@{
            GroupID = $SimilarGroups.Count + 1
            PrimaryName = $group[0].Name
            MatchCount = $group.Count
            Similarity = "High"
            Paths = ($group.FullPath -join "`n")
            TotalSizeMB = ($group | Measure-Object -Property SizeMB -Sum).Sum
            HasRemotes = ($group | Where-Object { $_.HasRemote }).Count
            AllRemotes = ($group | Where-Object { $_.RemoteUrl } | Select-Object -ExpandProperty RemoteUrl -Unique) -join "`n"
        }
    }
}

# Export duplicates
$ExactDuplicates | Select-Object Name, Count, @{N='Paths';E={($_.Group.FullPath -join "`n")}} | 
    Export-Csv "$OutputPath\2-EXACT-DUPLICATES.csv" -NoTypeInformation

$SimilarGroups | Export-Csv "$OutputPath\3-SIMILAR-NAMES.csv" -NoTypeInformation
Write-Host "✅ Found $($ExactDuplicates.Count) exact duplicates, $($SimilarGroups.Count) similar groups" -ForegroundColor Green

# ============================================
# PHASE 3: ACTION CATEGORIZATION
# ============================================
Write-Host "`n🔍 PHASE 3: Categorizing actions..." -ForegroundColor Cyan

$ArchiveCandidates = @()
$CombineCandidates = @()
$UpdateCandidates = @()
$KeepAsIs = @()

foreach ($repo in $AllRepos) {
    # Archive: No remote, old, clean, single branch
    if (-not $repo.HasRemote -and -not $repo.IsRecent -and $repo.GitStatus -eq "clean" -and $repo.BranchCount -le 1 -and $repo.SizeMB -lt 50) {
        $ArchiveCandidates += $repo
    }
    # Combine: Part of a duplicate/similar group
    elseif (($ExactDuplicates | Where-Object { $_.Name -eq $repo.Name }) -or 
            ($SimilarGroups | Where-Object { $_.Paths -contains $repo.FullPath })) {
        $CombineCandidates += $repo
    }
    # Update: Has remote but not recent, or dirty
    elseif ($repo.HasRemote -and (-not $repo.IsRecent -or $repo.GitStatus -eq "dirty")) {
        $UpdateCandidates += $repo
    }
    else {
        $KeepAsIs += $repo
    }
}

# Export categorized lists
$ArchiveCandidates | Export-Csv "$OutputPath\4-ARCHIVE-CANDIDATES.csv" -NoTypeInformation
$CombineCandidates | Export-Csv "$OutputPath\5-COMBINE-CANDIDATES.csv" -NoTypeInformation
$UpdateCandidates | Export-Csv "$OutputPath\6-UPDATE-CANDIDATES.csv" -NoTypeInformation
$KeepAsIs | Export-Csv "$OutputPath\7-KEEP-AS-IS.csv" -NoTypeInformation

# ============================================
# PHASE 4: GENERATE EXECUTIVE SUMMARY
# ============================================
Write-Host "`n📊 PHASE 4: Generating executive summary..." -ForegroundColor Cyan

$TotalSize = ($AllRepos | Measure-Object -Property SizeMB -Sum).Sum
$RemoteCount = ($AllRepos | Where-Object { $_.HasRemote }).Count
$RecentCount = ($AllRepos | Where-Object { $_.IsRecent }).Count
$DirtyCount = ($AllRepos | Where-Object { $_.GitStatus -eq "dirty" }).Count

$Summary = @"
# REPOSITORY AUDIT REPORT
**Generated:** $(Get-Date)
**Auditor:** Kimi Code PowerShell Engine
**Cutoff Date:** $OneMonthAgo

## 📊 HIGH-LEVEL METRICS
| Metric | Count |
|--------|-------|
| **Total Repositories** | $($AllRepos.Count) |
| **Total Size** | $([math]::Round($TotalSize, 2)) MB |
| **With Remotes** | $RemoteCount |
| **Updated (Last 30 Days)** | $RecentCount |
| **Uncommitted Changes** | $DirtyCount |
| **Exact Duplicates** | $($ExactDuplicates.Count) |
| **Similar Names** | $($SimilarGroups.Count) groups |

## 🎯 ACTION BREAKDOWN
| Action | Count | Est. Space Saved |
|--------|-------|------------------|
| **🗑️ ARCHIVE** | $($ArchiveCandidates.Count) | $([math]::Round(($ArchiveCandidates | Measure-Object -Property SizeMB -Sum).Sum, 2)) MB |
| **🔗 COMBINE** | $($CombineCandidates.Count) | $([math]::Round(($CombineCandidates | Measure-Object -Property SizeMB -Sum).Sum / 2, 2)) MB |
| **⬆️ UPDATE** | $($UpdateCandidates.Count) | - |
| **✅ KEEP** | $($KeepAsIs.Count) | - |

## 🔗 REMOTE REPOSITORIES
$($AllRepos | Where-Object { $_.HasRemote } | ForEach-Object { "- [$($_.Name)]($($_.RemoteUrl)) - $($_.FullPath)" } | Out-String)

## 🗑️ ARCHIVE CANDIDATES (Safe to Zip/Delete)
$($ArchiveCandidates | ForEach-Object { "- **$($_.Name)** | $($_.FullPath) | Last: $($_.LastModified.ToString('yyyy-MM-dd')) | $($_.SizeMB)MB" } | Out-String)

## 🔗 COMBINE CANDIDATES (Merge These)
$($SimilarGroups | ForEach-Object { 
    "### Group $($_.GroupID): $($_.PrimaryName) ($($_.MatchCount) matches)`n$($_.Paths -split "`n" | ForEach-Object { "- $_" } | Out-String)`n**Suggested:** Keep one with remote, archive others`n" 
} | Out-String)

## ⬆️ UPDATE CANDIDATES (Git Pull/Push Needed)
$($UpdateCandidates | ForEach-Object { "- **$($_.Name)** | $($_.GitStatus) | $($_.FullPath)" } | Out-String)

## 📁 OUTPUT FILES
All detailed CSVs saved to: $OutputPath

---
**Next Steps:**
1. Review `4-ARCHIVE-CANDIDATES.csv` → Zip and delete
2. Review `5-COMBINE-CANDIDATES.csv` → Merge repos
3. Run `git pull` on `6-UPDATE-CANDIDATES.csv`
"@

$Summary | Out-File "$OutputPath\0-EXECUTIVE-SUMMARY.md" -Encoding utf8

# ============================================

# ============================================
Write-Host "`n⚡ PHASE 5: Generating action scripts..." -ForegroundColor Cyan

# Archive script

`$ArchiveDate = Get-Date -Format "yyyy-MM-dd"
`$ArchiveDir = "`$env:USERPROFILE\ArchivedRepos_`$ArchiveDate"
New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path `$ArchiveDir -Force

# Update script

# ============================================

Write-Host "`n✅ AUDIT COMPLETE!" -ForegroundColor Green
