## Prompt to Find Credential Files
- Account: account1
- Created: 2026-07-03T02:40:52Z

**User:** I now need a prompt for kimi coed to go through all repos in my dekan ai user folder and dekstop and everywhere to find any credentials cred files for en vartoiables such as deepgram azure and have it review with me to make one var file

**Assistant:** Memory updated       Here's your Kimi Code prompt — copy-paste ready, no explanations needed:powershell   Copy # === KIMI CODE PROMPT: CREDENTIAL AUDIT & CONSOLIDATION ===
# Task: Scan all repos for scattered credentials/env files, review them with user, and create ONE master .env file

# --- CONFIG ---
$searchPaths = @(
    "$env:USERPROFILE\Desktop",
    "$env:USERPROFILE",
    "$env:USERPROFILE\Documents",
    "$env:USERPROFILE\source",
    "$env:USERPROFILE\repos"
)
$envFileName = ".env"
$masterEnvPath = "$env:USERPROFILE\master-credentials.env"
$reviewLogPath = "$env:USERPROFILE\credential-audit-log.md"

# --- STEP 1: DISCOVERY ---
# Find ALL .env, .env.local, .env.production, credentials.json, config.json, secrets.* files
$credentialFiles = @()
$patterns = @("*.env*", "credentials*", "secrets*", "config.json", "azure.json", "deepgram.json", "api-keys*")

foreach ($path in $searchPaths) {
    if (Test-Path $path) {
        foreach ($pattern in $patterns) {
            $found = Get-ChildItem -Path $path -Recurse -Filter $pattern -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue -Force
            $credentialFiles += $found
        }
    }
}

# Deduplicate and sort
$credentialFiles = $credentialFiles | Select-Object -Property FullName, LastWriteTime, Length -Unique | Sort-Object FullName

# --- STEP 2: EXTRACT & PARSE ---
$allSecrets = @()
foreach ($file in $credentialFiles) {
    $content = Get-Content -Path $file.FullName -Raw -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
    $lines = $content -split "`n"
    
    foreach ($line in $lines) {
        # Match KEY=VALUE patterns (skip comments and empty lines)
        if ($line -match '^\s*([A-Za-z0-9_]+)\s*=\s*(.+)\s*$') {
            $key = $matches[1].Trim()
            $value = $matches[2].Trim().Trim('"').Trim("'")
            
            # Flag known credential patterns
            $isCredential = $key -match '(?i)(key|token|secret|password|api|azure|deepgram|openai|groq|anthropic|aws|gcp|firebase|supabase|mongo|postgres|db_|auth|jwt|webhook)'
            
            $allSecrets += [PSCustomObject]@{
                SourceFile = $file.FullName
                Key = $key
                Value = $value
                IsCredential = $isCredential
                IsPlaceholder = $value -match '(?i)(your_|placeholder|example|dummy|test|xxx|todo|change)'
                Line = $line.Trim()
            }
        }
    }
}

# --- STEP 3: GROUP BY KEY & DETECT CONFLICTS ---
$grouped = $allSecrets | Group-Object Key
$conflicts = $grouped | Where-Object { $_.Count -gt 1 -and ($_.Group | Select-Object Value -Unique).Count -gt 1 }

# --- STEP 4: GENERATE REVIEW LOG ---
$reviewLog = @"
# Credential Audit Log — $(Get-Date -Format "yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm")
## Files Scanned: $($credentialFiles.Count)
## Total Variables Found: $($allSecrets.Count)
## Conflicts Detected: $($conflicts.Count)

### Files Found:
$($credentialFiles | ForEach-Object { "- $($_.FullName)" } | Out-String)

### All Variables:
$($allSecrets | ForEach-Object { "| $($_.Key) | $($_.SourceFile) | $(if($_.IsCredential){'🔴'}else{'🟢'}) | $(if($_.IsPlaceholder){'⚠️ PLACEHOLDER'}else{'ACTIVE'}) |" } | Out-String)

### CONFLICTS (Same key, different values):
$($conflicts | ForEach-Object { 
    $key = $_.Name
    $vals = $_.Group | Select-Object Value, SourceFile -Unique
    "**$key** found in:`n$($vals | ForEach-Object { "- $($_.SourceFile): $($_.Value.Substring(0,[Math]::Min(20,$_.Value.Length)))..." } | Out-String)"
} | Out-String)

### REVIEW CHECKLIST:
- [ ] Verify each key is still needed
- [ ] Resolve conflicts (pick correct value)
- [ ] Mark placeholders for update
- [ ] Delete old .env files after migration
- [ ] Add .env to .gitignore in all repos
"@

$reviewLog | Out-File -FilePath $reviewLogPath -Encoding utf8

# --- STEP 5: BUILD MASTER ENV (DRY RUN - SHOW ONLY) ---
$masterEnv = @"
# Master Credentials File — Generated $(Get-Date -Format "yyyy-MM-dd")
# REVIEW REQUIRED: This is a DRY RUN. Uncomment Write-Host below to write file.
# Source: Consolidated from $($credentialFiles.Count) files
# 
# === AZURE ===
# DEEPGRAM ===
# OPENAI / ANTHROPIC / GROQ ===
# DATABASE / SUPABASE ===
# OTHER ===

"@

# Build unique keys (prefer non-placeholder values, flag conflicts)
$uniqueKeys = $allSecrets | Where-Object { -not $_.IsPlaceholder } | Group-Object Key | ForEach-Object {
    $best = $_.Group | Sort-Object { $_.IsPlaceholder } | Select-Object -First 1
    $comment = if ($_.Count -gt 1) { " # CONFLICT: $($_.Count) sources" } else { " # From: $(Split-Path $best.SourceFile -Leaf)" }
    "$($best.Key)=$($best.Value)$comment"
}

$masterEnv += ($uniqueKeys | Sort-Object) -join "`n"

# Show everything to user
Write-Host "`n=== FILES FOUND ($($credentialFiles.Count)) ===" -ForegroundColor Cyan
$credentialFiles | Format-Table FullName, LastWriteTime, Length -AutoSize

Write-Host "`n=== CONFLICTS ($($conflicts.Count)) ===" -ForegroundColor Red
$conflicts | ForEach-Object {
    Write-Host "`n$($_.Name) appears in $($_.Count) files with different values:" -ForegroundColor Yellow
    $_.Group | Select-Object SourceFile, Value -Unique | Format-Table -AutoSize
}

Write-Host "`n=== MASTER ENV PREVIEW (DRY RUN) ===" -ForegroundColor Green
Write-Host $masterEnv

Write-Host "`n=== PLACEHOLDERS DETECTED ===" -ForegroundColor Magenta
$allSecrets | Where-Object { $_.IsPlaceholder } | Format-Table Key, SourceFile -AutoSize

Write-Host "`n=== NEXT STEPS ===" -ForegroundColor Cyan
Write-Host "1. Review: $reviewLogPath"
Write-Host "2. Resolve conflicts above"
Write-Host "3. Uncomment the Out-File line below to write master env"
Write-Host "4. After verification, delete old .env files and add .env to .gitignore"

# --- STEP 6: WRITE MASTER ENV (UNCOMMENT AFTER REVIEW) ---
# $masterEnv | Out-File -FilePath $masterEnvPath -Encoding utf8
# Write-Host "Master env written to: $masterEnvPath" -ForegroundColor Green

# --- STEP 7: GITIGNORE CHECK ---
Write-Host "`n=== .GITIGNORE CHECK ===" -ForegroundColor Yellow
$gitignoreFiles = Get-ChildItem -Path $searchPaths -Recurse -Filter ".gitignore" -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
foreach ($gitignore in $gitignoreFiles) {
    $content = Get-Content $gitignore.FullName -Raw
    if ($content -notmatch '\.env') {
        Write-Host "MISSING .env in: $($gitignore.FullName)" -ForegroundColor Red
    }
} What it does:Scans Desktop, user folder, Documents, source, repos for all .env*, credentials*, secrets*, config.json filesParses KEY=VALUE pairs and flags known credential patterns (Azure, Deepgram, OpenAI, DB, etc.)Detects conflicts — same key with different values across filesGenerates review log (credential-audit-log.md) with markdown table of everything foundShows master env preview (dry run) — doesn't write until you uncomment Step 6Checks .gitignore — flags repos missing .env so you don't leak credentials againAfter you run it:Review the conflicts in redOpen credential-audit-log.md in your editorPick the correct value for each conflicted keyUncomment the Out-File line in Step 6 to write the master fileThen delete the scattered old env files and add .env to .gitignore in every repoBAMMM. One source of truth. No more credential sprawl.                                                       Ask away. Pics work too.                       K2.6 Instant

    "groq[_-]?api[_-]?key",                   # Groq
    "azure[_-]?key",                          # Azure
    "deepgram[_-]?api[_-]?key",               # Deepgram
    "runway[_-]?api[_-]?key",                # Runway
    "vercel[_-]?token",                       # Vercel
    "openrouter[_-]?api[_-]?key",            # OpenRouter
    "cartesia[_-]?api[_-]?key",              # Cartesia
    "elevenlabs[_-]?api[_-]?key",            # ElevenLabs
    "anthropic[_-]?api[_-]?key",             # Anthropic
    "google[_-]?api[_-]?key",                # Google
    "firebase[_-]?api[_-]?key",              # Firebase
    "supabase[_-]?key",                       # Supabase
    "neon[_-]?api[_-]?key",                   # Neon
    "planetscale[_-]?token",                  # PlanetScale
    "mongodb[_-]?uri",                        # MongoDB
    "redis[_-]?url",                          # Redis
    "postgres[_-]?url",                       # PostgreSQL
    "mysql[_-]?url",                          # MySQL
    "docker[_-]?hub[_-]?token",              # Docker Hub
    "npm[_-]?token",                          # NPM
    "pypi[_-]?token"                          # PyPI
)

# Service/Platform Names (import statements, SDK usage, config references)
$servicePatterns = @(
    "vercel", "groq", "azure", "openai", "anthropic", "claude", "deepgram",
    "runway", "replicate", "elevenlabs", "cartesia", "openrouter", "groq",
    "huggingface", "pinecone", "weaviate", "chromadb", "supabase", "firebase",
    "neon", "planetscale", "mongodb", "redis", "postgres", "mysql", "sqlite",
    "docker", "kubernetes", "aws", "gcp", "google.cloud", "cloudflare",
    "stripe", "twilio", "sendgrid", "resend", "mailgun", "postmark",
    "auth0", "clerk", "nextauth", "supabase.auth", "firebase.auth",
    "vercel.ai", "ai-sdk", "langchain", "llamaindex", "crewai", "autogen",
    "semantic-kernel", "haystack", "transformers", "diffusers", "gradio",
    "streamlit", "chainlit", "fastapi", "flask", "django", "express",
    "next.js", "nuxt", "sveltekit", "remix", "astro", "solidjs",
    "tailwind", "shadcn", "radix", "framer-motion", "three.js", "webgl",
    "playwright", "puppeteer", "selenium", "cypress", "jest", "vitest",
    "pytest", "mocha", "github", "gitlab", "bitbucket", "jira", "linear",
    "notion", "slack", "discord", "teams", "zoom", "figma", "linear"
)

# File extensions to scan
$extensions = @("*.js", "*.ts", "*.jsx", "*.tsx", "*.py", "*.json", "*.yaml", "*.yml", "*.toml", "*.ini", "*.cfg", "*.env*", "*.sh", "*.ps1", "*.md", "*.txt", "*.html", "*.css", "*.scss", "*.sql", "*.prisma", "*.graphql", "*.dockerfile", "*.tf", "*.hcl")

# === EXECUTE SCAN ===
New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path $outputDir | Out-Null
$results = [System.Collections.Generic.List[PSObject]]::new()

foreach ($basePath in $scanPaths) {
    if (-not (Test-Path $basePath)) { continue }
    
    Write-Host "🔍 Scanning: $basePath" -ForegroundColor Cyan
    
    foreach ($ext in $extensions) {
        $files = Get-ChildItem -Path $basePath -Filter $ext -Recurse -File -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Where-Object {
            $path = $_.FullName
            $skip = $false
            foreach ($ex in $excludeDirs) {
                if ($path -like "*\$ex\*") { $skip = $true; break }
            }
            -not $skip
        }
        
        foreach ($file in $files) {
            $content = Get-Content -Path $file.FullName -Raw -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
            if (-not $content) { continue }
            
            $lines = $content -split "`n"
            
            # Check for API key patterns
            for ($i = 0; $i -lt $lines.Count; $i++) {
                $line = $lines[$i]
                foreach ($pattern in $apiKeyPatterns) {
                    if ($line -match $pattern) {
                        $results.Add([PSCustomObject]@{
                            Type = "API_KEY"
                            Service = ($pattern -split "[_-]")[0].ToUpper()
                            Pattern = $pattern
                            File = $file.FullName
                            Line = ($i + 1)
                            Snippet = ($line.Trim() -replace "['""][a-zA-Z0-9_-]{10,}['""]", "'***REDACTED***'")
                            Category = "Credential"
                        })
                    }
                }
            }
            
            # Check for service/platform references
            $contentLower = $content.ToLower()
            foreach ($service in $servicePatterns) {
                $matches = [regex]::Matches($contentLower, "\b$service\b")
                if ($matches.Count -gt 0) {
                    $results.Add([PSCustomObject]@{
                        Type = "SERVICE_REF"
                        Service = $service.ToUpper()
                        Pattern = $service
                        File = $file.FullName
                        Line = "N/A (multiple)"
                        Snippet = "Found $($matches.Count) references"
                        Category = "Platform"
                    })
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

# === DEDUPLICATE & ORGANIZE ===
$uniqueResults = $results | Group-Object -Property File, Service | ForEach-Object {
    $first = $_.Group | Select-Object -First 1
    $lines = ($_.Group | Where-Object { $_.Line -ne "N/A (multiple)" } | Select-Object -ExpandProperty Line -Unique) -join ", "
    if (-not $lines) { $lines = "N/A" }
    [PSCustomObject]@{
        Type = $first.Type
        Service = $first.Service
        File = $first.File
        Lines = $lines
        Occurrences = $_.Count
        Category = $first.Category
    }
}

# === GENERATE MARKDOWN INVENTORY ===
$md = @"
# 🔌 Third-Party API & Service Inventory
**Generated:** $(Get-Date -Format "yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss")  
**Scanned Paths:** $($scanPaths -join ", ")  
**Total Findings:** $($uniqueResults.Count)

---

## 📊 Summary by Service

"@

$serviceSummary = $uniqueResults | Group-Object Service | Sort-Object Count -Descending
foreach ($svc in $serviceSummary) {
    $md += "`n### $($svc.Name) ($($svc.Count) files)`n"
    foreach ($item in $svc.Group | Sort-Object File) {
        $md += "- **$($item.File)** | Lines: $($item.Lines) | Type: $($item.Type) | Occurrences: $($item.Occurrences)`n"
    }
}

$md += @"

---

## 📁 Summary by Project/Repo

"@

$repoSummary = $uniqueResults | Group-Object { ($_.File -split "\\")[0..4] -join "\\" }
foreach ($repo in $repoSummary) {
    $md += "`n### $($repo.Name)`n"
    foreach ($item in $repo.Group | Sort-Object Service) {
        $md += "- **$($item.Service)** | File: $(Split-Path $item.File -Leaf) | Lines: $($item.Lines)`n"
    }
}

$md += @"

---

## 🔐 Credential Files Found

"@

$credFiles = $uniqueResults | Where-Object { $_.Category -eq "Credential" } | Select-Object File -Unique
if ($credFiles) {
    foreach ($cf in $credFiles) {
        $md += "- $($cf.File)`n"
    }
} else {
    $md += "_No explicit credential files found._`n"
}

$md += @"

---

## 🎯 Action Items
- [ ] Review each service for active usage vs. dead code
- [ ] Rotate any exposed API keys
- [ ] Consolidate duplicate service integrations
- [ ] Document service-to-project mapping
- [ ] Check for unused services incurring costs

---

*Inventory generated by Kimi Code API Scanner*
"@

# === OUTPUT ===
$md | Out-File -FilePath $inventoryFile -Encoding UTF8
Write-Host "`n✅ Inventory saved to: $inventoryFile" -ForegroundColor Green
Write-Host "📊 Services found: $($serviceSummary.Count)" -ForegroundColor Yellow
Write-Host "🔐 Credential references: $(($uniqueResults | Where-Object Category -eq 'Credential').Count)" -ForegroundColor Red

# Also export CSV for spreadsheet review
$uniqueResults | Export-Csv -Path "$outputDir\api_inventory_$timestamp.csv" -NoTypeInformation -Encoding UTF8
Write-Host "📄 CSV exported to: $outputDir\api_inventory_$timestamp.csv" -ForegroundColor Green

# === OPTIONAL: CREATE CONSOLIDATED .ENV TEMPLATE ===
$envTemplate = @"
# === CONSOLIDATED SERVICE CONFIGURATION ===
# Generated: $(Get-Date -Format "yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss")
# Review each key and uncomment only active services

# AI / LLM
# OPENAI_API_KEY=your_key_here
# ANTHROPIC_API_KEY=your_key_here
# GROQ_API_KEY=your_key_here
# AZURE_OPENAI_KEY=your_key_here
# AZURE_OPENAI_ENDPOINT=your_endpoint_here
# OPENROUTER_API_KEY=your_key_here

# Voice / Audio
# DEEPGRAM_API_KEY=your_key_here
# ELEVENLABS_API_KEY=your_key_here
# CARTESIA_API_KEY=your_key_here

# Image / Video
# RUNWAY_API_KEY=your_key_here
# REPLICATE_API_TOKEN=your_key_here

# Database / Storage
# SUPABASE_URL=your_url_here
# SUPABASE_KEY=your_key_here
# NEON_DATABASE_URL=your_url_here
# MONGODB_URI=your_uri_here
# REDIS_URL=your_url_here

# Deployment / Hosting
# VERCEL_TOKEN=your_token_here
# AZURE_CONTAINER_REGISTRY=your_registry_here

# Auth
# CLERK_SECRET_KEY=your_key_here
# AUTH0_SECRET=your_secret_here

# Other
# HUGGINGFACE_TOKEN=your_token_here
# STRIPE_SECRET_KEY=your_key_here
"@

$envTemplate | Out-File -FilePath "$outputDir\.env.template" -Encoding UTF8
Write-Host "📝 .env template created at: $outputDir\.env.template" -ForegroundColor Cyan What It DoesTable  Copy   PhaseAction ScanRecursively searches all your repos/scripts for API keys, service imports, config referencesDetectMatches 50+ services (Vercel, Groq, Azure, OpenAI, Deepgram, Runway, Supabase, etc.)InventoryBuilds a markdown report with file paths, line numbers, occurrence countsOrganizeGroups by service AND by project so you see both viewsTemplateGenerates a .env.template with all discovered services for consolidationExportSaves CSV for spreadsheet review + Markdown for documentationOutput Filesplain   Copy C:\Users\Dekan AI Brother\api-inventory\
├── api_inventory_20260615_0210.md      # Master markdown report
